today.empty_body:
Day 1 cap: 2 habits max. Research shows more leads to giving up within 14 days.
Pick a tiny version you'll do tonight.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.subtitle:
Define your own reward cards. Draw one when you finish a habit and unlock it.
System identity cards stay as consolation prizes — add your own for rare+.
rewards.add_hint:
e.g. "Play 30 min of game", "Have an ice cream", "Buy a coffee", "One Netflix episode".
Higher rarity = lower draw odds, but bigger XP bonus.
rewards.form_copy_placeholder: Optional. If empty: "___ · what you earned today."

onboarding.title: Pick a tiny version
onboarding.subtitle: Don't think big. Write 1 line of code, read 1 page, do 1 push-up. BJ Fogg: tiny first, scale later.
onboarding.at_cap_body:
Research consensus: practice only 1-2 habits in the first 21 days. The system unlocks more after 21 days.
Focus on these two for now.
onboarding.form_type_hint_daily: Daily must. Always do the tiny version. Missing one day is OK; missing two triggers an alert.
onboarding.form_type_hint_weekly: Hit weekly target X/7. More forgiving for habits that aren't daily.
onboarding.form_if_then_hint: Format: "After ___, I will ___ at ___". Gollwitzer's research: filling this in raises follow-through 60%.
onboarding.form_if_then_placeholder: After breakfast → open IDE and write 1 line of code (at desk)
onboarding.preset_vibe_if_then: After breakfast → open IDE and write 1 line of code (at desk)
onboarding.preset_read_if_then: Before bed → read 1 page of a print book (at bedside)
